title: Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance - Clock Tower (Steel Ball Room)
description:
One of the backgrounds of the Clock Tower, seen in a room where Juste has to race a Steel Ball, to avoid it from blocking his way to some important items. A good pick for ruins or caves in general. Includes Castle A and Castle B palettes. The background can be expanded vertically with some clever map 16 edits.

Credit would be great, but is optional,.
